notes: https://infra.market/careers/ publishes a single hr1.to short link (https://hr1.to//56f9dd) that lands on the company-branded HROne portal https://career.hrone.cloud/career-portal?appId=...&dc=infra&rqt=...&cc=.... The portal queries POST https://gateway.app.hrone.cloud/api/external/public/referral/CareerPosition/Details with headers domainCode=infra, apiKey=<appId>, AccessMode=W and a JSON body of filter keys (departmentCode, companyCode, careerPortalType, jobTitle, employmentType, seniorityName, jobFunction, businessUnitCode, department, subDepartment, gradeCode, designationCode, levelCode, branchCode, subBranchCode, regionCode, locationId, preferredLocationId, experience, qualification, skillsName, urgentOpening, jobPosted, isShortUrl, nationality, pagination) plus jobPosted='0' and pagination {pageNumber,pageSize}. Sending all filters empty returns HTTP 200 [] and the rendered portal shows 'CURRENTLY NO VACANCIES'.
